The port does not define +new either, because the rule the coordinator settled on 2026-10-03 (coordination/wave-2026-10-03/QUEUE.md): a definition would put the selector in the port's metadata where Apple's has none, changing what the class is and answering the caller exactly what NSObject's already answers
entries.effect: not defined by the port; +new is NSObject's, so it allocates and sends -init, which raises the exception above, which is what the framework's own class answers
